verses.text: Hear this word which the LORD has spoken against you, sons of Israel, against the entire family which He brought up from the land of Egypt:
verses.textZh: 以色列人哪，你們全家是我從埃及地領上來的，當聽耶和華攻擊你們的話：

verses.text: 'You only have I chosen among all the families of the earth; Therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.'
verses.textZh: 在地上萬族中，我只認識你們；因此，我必追討你們的一切罪孽。

verses.text: Do two men walk together unless they have made an appointment?
verses.textZh: 二人若不同心，豈能同行呢？

verses.text: Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Does a young lion growl from his den unless he has captured [something]?
verses.textZh: 獅子若非抓食，豈能在林中咆哮呢？少壯獅子若無所得，豈能從洞中發聲呢？

verses.text: Does a bird fall into a trap on the ground when there is no bait in it? Does a trap spring up from the earth when it captures nothing at all?
verses.textZh: 若沒有機檻，雀鳥豈能陷在網羅裡呢？網羅若無所得，豈能從地上翻起呢？

verses.text: If a trumpet is blown in a city will not the people tremble? If a calamity occurs in a city has not the LORD done it?
verses.textZh: 城中若吹角，百姓豈不驚恐呢？災禍若臨到一城，豈非耶和華所降的麼？

verses.text: Surely the Lord GOD does nothing Unless He reveals His secret counsel To His servants the prophets.
verses.textZh: 主耶和華若不將奧秘指示他的僕人─眾先知，就一無所行。

verses.text: A lion has roared! Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken! Who can but prophesy?
verses.textZh: 獅子吼叫，誰不懼怕呢？主耶和華發命，誰能不說預言呢？

verses.text: Proclaim on the citadels in Ashdod and on the citadels in the land of Egypt and say, 'Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria and see [the] great tumults within her and [the] oppressions in her midst.
verses.textZh: 要在亞實突的宮殿中和埃及地的宮殿裡傳揚說：你們要聚集在撒瑪利亞的山上，就看見城中有何等大的擾亂與欺壓的事。

verses.text: 'But they do not know how to do what is right,' declares the LORD, 'these who hoard up violence and devastation in their citadels.'
verses.textZh: 那些以強暴搶奪財物、積蓄在自己家中的人不知道行正直的事。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD, 'An enemy, even one surrounding the land, Will pull down your strength from you And your citadels will be looted.'
verses.textZh: 所以主耶和華如此說：敵人必來圍攻這地，使你的勢力衰微，搶掠你的家宅。

verses.text: Thus says the LORD, 'Just as the shepherd snatches from the lion's mouth a couple of legs or a piece of an ear, So will the sons of Israel dwelling in Samaria be snatched away-- With [the] corner of a bed and [the] cover of a couch!
verses.textZh: 耶和華如此說：牧人怎樣從獅子口中搶回兩條羊腿或半個耳朵，住撒瑪利亞的以色列人躺臥在床角上或鋪繡花毯的榻上，他們得救也不過如此。

verses.text: 'Hear and testify against the house of Jacob,' Declares the Lord GOD, the God of hosts.
verses.textZh: 主耶和華─萬軍之神說：當聽這話，警戒雅各家。

verses.text: 'For on the day that I punish Israel's transgressions, I will also punish the altars of Bethel; The horns of the altar will be cut off And they will fall to the ground.
verses.textZh: 我討以色列罪的日子，也要討伯特利祭壇的罪；壇角必被砍下，墜落於地。

verses.text: 'I will also smite the winter house together with the summer house; The houses of ivory will also perish And the great houses will come to an end,' Declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 我要拆毀過冬和過夏的房屋。象牙的房屋也必毀滅；高大的房屋都歸無有。這是耶和華說的。
